output.initial_state_contract: Original PRNG constructor initializes six bytes and retains two uninitialized bytes. Actual cold states differ; none were forced or fitted. Strict same-state output equivalence is not admitted.

limits: Canonical asset spans only, not semantic identification of every remaining byte.
Two complete title frames per capture; not whole-route DMA coverage.
Copper bounds are the moved image, not a separate per-list execution proof.
Blitter object/alias bounds and unobserved sprites are not qualified here.
Historical null sprite0/2 behaviour remains an explicit exception, not a moved asset claim.
Both cold runs complete 576 phases with HP49 and natural DOS return; all ten exact frees follow DMA quiescence.

Five later gameplay images match; early title crop, UI pixels, settled title and unshifted Paula/master PCM do not. Initial clock/PRNG states differ, so this is not a strict output-equivalence pass or evidence attributing differences to a relocation defect.

86 source-selected asset spans (290180 bytes), eleven primary audio records plus silence/secondary audio, and blank sprite bytes are unchanged. Sampled audio/Copper/bitplane DMA bounds pass in two title frames per capture, not all paths or all DMA.
The separate two-frame combat sample observes one CPU read from the moved high-mask root and no direct high-mask DMA transfer; no transfer outside semantic extent is observed there.
The original byte-exact export, prior fixed builds, and explicit six/seven-owner compatibility adapters remain; one shared loader/planner emits them.
Retained carrier and display remain fixed. Unexplained suffix bytes are preserved, not declared unused or freed.
Eight-CCK original-to-image and broader all-path obligations remain open. ROM, payloads, extracted assets and raw audio/images stay private.
